what: Keycloak self sign-up has no model setting. The catalog's multi-tenant realm page says the exported realm does not set registrationAllowed, and the only documented route is the Java RealmManager. The seed script PUTs the realm with registrationAllowed=true instead.
why: The realm is emitted by asm2keycloak with loginWithEmailAllowed only; no model attribute exposes registrationAllowed.
workaround: scripts/seed-dev-user.sh PUTs the realm after each fresh Keycloak volume (R7-4 still open).

what: The generated integration-test module pom declares hu.blackbelt.osgi.i18n:i18n-api with an empty version element, so the module cannot build. kb search for the integration-test module did not return this, and the catalog does not document the empty version.
why: Generator output defect in the integration-test module; the documented route (mvn in application/integration-test) does not work for this project.
workaround: Hand-written order-tests module (carried from R12-5); the generated pom is not edited.

what: The generated Playwright config sets retries: 4 unconditionally; the catalog note in playwright.ci.config.ts recommends the conditional form (retries only in CI). The builder's review notes the default config is parallel with 4 retries.
why: Generated default differs from the catalog's recommended form.
workaround: Used playwright.local.config.ts with workers 1 and retries 0 (L6339).

what: Adding a third actor (PaymentGateway, kind SYSTEM, anonymous) makes the generated admin frontend fail biome format: 'Declarations inside of a import declaration may not have duplicates' (for example import type { CsvFile, CsvFile, CsvFileStored, CsvFileStored }). Build reports 120 errors in admin. Removing the actor fixes it; the same error occurs with any third actor, whatever its kind.
why: The judo-ui-react actor template helper (getApiImportsForPage, classDataName) returns each type twice when an operation has both an input and an output, and the admin module has several such operations.
workaround: Deleted the PaymentGateway actor and gave the webhook operation an Admin access instead (see c12-24); admin build passed after that.

what: Every start logs ERROR 'LiquibaseModelDataSourcePrehook: Could not find compatible schema model' (NoClassDefFoundError EolExecutionContext from judo.meta.rdbms.osgi). /system/health stays 503 'Missing platform components: PersistenceReady, InitScriptsCompleted', while the app serves requests.
why: CheckRdbmsModelCompatibility cannot load a class from the epsilon runtime; a platform packaging problem, present since R1 per the builder.
workaround: None; the app runs. Health stays 503.

what: A third actor (anonymous SYSTEM actor PaymentGateway) makes the generated admin frontend build fail at pnpm run format (biome: duplicate identifiers in one import declaration, e.g. import type { CsvFile, CsvFile, ... }). Gone when the actor is removed. The builder dropped the anonymous webhook and used a bearer-token call to the Admin actor plus an HMAC signature instead.
why: Generator bug in the admin frontend template helper (getApiImportsForPage / classDataName returns the type twice); contradicts the catalog's anonymous-actor guidance for public entry points.
workaround: Removed the anonymous actor; F72 webhook is a static operation called with the Admin bearer token plus HMAC signature (GAPS R16-4).
proposed_target: judo generator: ui-react admin frontend import generation (duplicate type imports)

what: The generated admin UI never sends __version, so two admins editing the same product silently overwrite each other (stock 11 became 7). Optimistic locking does not protect UI edits.
why: Generated admin edit form omits the version member; catalog says clients echo __version but the generated UI does not.
workaround: Added ProductConflictInterceptor that refuses a stale save with a 422 CONFLICT.
proposed_target: judo generator: admin UI edit payload should echo __version

what: Level 9a checkout failed: the digits of the typed address (Lake Road 9, 5003) landed in the Loyalty points to spend field, which has focus when the checkout dialog opens (the field showed 95,003), so the order was refused and the helper got no order number.
why: Generated checkout dialog starts with focus in the loyalty points field; the spec did not clear it (level 8 did).
workaround: openCheckout in level9a clears the points field and blurs it before the address and checkout; the helper waits for the field to be empty.
proposed_target: judo generator: checkout dialog initial focus

what: Customer order detail custom layout showed 0 order lines in the DOM while the database had 3 lines for order WS-2026-000311.
why: Not established; the lines are a relation table inside the order view, and the check was done with a wrong DB column name first.
workaround: None yet; investigation left open at the end of the chunk.

what: The generated cards container toolbar is an empty stub (DefaultToolbar renders an empty div), and a cards container shows no table operations, no loading state and no empty state, so the builder wrote its own toolbar and action bar.
why: Generator ships a placeholder default toolbar; the catalog cards blueprint does not say the toolbar must be replaced.
workaround: Wrote shared ListBars (toolbar and action bar) and ShopCard components, registered via the cards configuration hook.

what: The generated horizontal navigation (ScrollableMenu) reserves two 60 px slots for its scroll arrows, so the nav is narrower than the bar; the builder overrode it with attribute-selector CSS on inline styles.
why: Generated layout component; the builder's own reading of ScrollableMenu.tsx.
workaround: CSS override in AppBarExtras.tsx matching div[style*="flex: 0 0 auto"] (fragile).

what: Customer order-detail line cards were empty; the browser logged 'TypeError: fetch is not a function'. The generated LinesComponent passes actions.linesRefreshAction to the cards container, but the customer view page does not provide it.
why: A card container for a to-many relation inside a view calls actions.<relation>RefreshAction, which the generated view page never supplies.
workaround: Replaced the relation cards with a custom RelationCards component that loads rows through the generated list service (registerRelationCards.tsx); lines show again.
proposed_target: relation cards container refresh action in the generated view page

what: The relation proxy (TableProxyProps) carries no refreshCounter, so a card list inside a view cannot refresh after a row action; the builder reloads its own list after delete and remove.
why: TableProxyProps in custom/interfaces.ts has ownerData, isOwnerLoading, actions, editMode, storeDiff, isFormUpdateable only.
workaround: Card list calls its own load() after rowDeleteAction or removeAction.

what: After the machine rebooted, Docker was not running and postgres-webshop and keycloak-webshop had exited; the round restarted Docker, Postgres, Keycloak, backend and Vite and kept the data (383 orders at restart).
why: Host reboot; Docker daemon was down.
workaround: open -a Docker, docker start, judo.sh start, Vite on 5173.

what: During the final runs Docker's disk went read-only ('read-only file system'); postgres-webshop exited with code 255 and needed a Docker restart; Postgres recovered its WAL and the 602 orders were intact.
why: Docker Desktop VM storage fault on the host.
workaround: Quit and reopened Docker Desktop and started the containers.

what: Keycloak login page (#kc-form-login) was not visible within 15 to 40 s in many admin and customer specs; Keycloak logged normal startup, so the cause is slow login or the environment.
why: Environment load after the DB restart; not a product defect shown in the log.
workaround: Timeouts raised to 40 s in adminPage and login helpers.

what: Company pages take 4 to 9 s with 148 products and 118 companies: the company price rows compute derived product fields (onSale, lowStock, priceLabel) for every product of the join; order, product and category lists answer in under 0.5 s.
why: pg_stat_activity shows the derived-field SELECT over the company price join; the cost grows with products and companies.
workaround: Specs wait up to 45 s (slowOpen helper); logged as R16U-13 with a suggestion to map fewer fields.

what: Admin invite with a mixed-case e-mail (Ann@X.com): after two invites the table had no row with the normalised address, so the test found 0 rows; the cause is not established in the chunk.
why: Unknown; possibly normalisation or the invite dialog.
workaround: None in the chunk; the test was still failing at the last run.

what: In pw-r16u-q 14 of 15 failures waited 40 s for #kc-form-login. Keycloak looked healthy when checked afterwards (0 restarts, no OOM, 2-10 ms discovery answers, port 8280 not 8080). The builder blamed load from other Docker stacks on the same VM.
why: Root cause not established; the 15 specs passed on rerun (17 passed, 15.3 min) without any change.
workaround: Reran the failing specs serially with -c playwright.local.config.ts; recorded in GAPS R16U-18.

what: Docker Desktop VM disk went read-only during a long Playwright run; Docker Desktop was restarted and Postgres recovered (602 orders afterwards).
why: Docker VM disk filled during the long runs on the shared machine.
workaround: Restarted Docker Desktop and Postgres; data kept.

what: A cards container placed inside a view fails with 'fetch is not a function', and the relation proxy gets no refresh counter.
why: Custom relation lists read through the generated service; the cards container path is not wired for that case.
workaround: Relation lists built as custom elements that read through the generated service.

what: A detail view cannot be replaced as a whole, so every field of the order, quote, sale, return, wallet, seller, company and notification detail needed its own custom element (93 field elements).
why: Custom visual element extension point works per field, not per view.
workaround: Custom detail layouts built per field element with DetailLayout.

what: Company pages take 4 to 9 seconds with the shared data; the specs wait up to 45 s and the company pages are still slow.
why: Model performance with this data volume (company relations).
workaround: Specs tolerate the delay; no fix.

what: Startup log at ERROR: LiquibaseModelDataSourcePrehook 'Could not find compatible schema model' with NoClassDefFoundError for hu/blackbelt/epsilon/runtime/execution/contexts/EolExecutionContext after schema-upgrade. The builder filtered these lines out of its checks and did not follow them up.
why: Missing epsilon runtime class in the Karaf runtime; cause not investigated.
workaround: None; filtered out of the health check.

what: Frontend model build printed many 'XMI ID COLLISION DETECTED' errors for TabularReferenceField link actions (Admin model) after the new admin cards. The head of the output was checked; the BUILD result of that run was not read.
why: Unknown; possibly the new admin tables or the translation step.
workaround: None recorded.

what: Import of 5000 rows takes about 2.5 minutes; undo about 40 seconds; the Import runs card list does not refresh by itself.
why: Two DAO writes per product; UI has no auto-refresh for the run list.
workaround: Spec reopens the screen; Refresh button used.

what: filterBy(String) cannot navigate relations, and there is no inverse relation from CustomerAccount to its orders.
why: Catalog says the custom JQL filter does not support relation navigation.
workaround: Design around the limit with native SQL or separate lookups.

what: Build failed in frontend-react-model with 'Verify UI model is presented' after the exportMyData file operation was added; validate --strict passed; deleting the two operations from the Form and Table views and rebuilding gave BUILD SUCCESS.
why: Maven UI validation fails for an INSTANCE operation with file output while judo validate passes (cause not fully known).
workaround: Removed the file operations from the views, rebuilt.

what: Each build logs about 10 XMI ID COLLISION errors in e2e-model and frontend-react-model (ID reassigned between Action objects of TabularReferenceField actions).
why: Platform model transform reuses XMI IDs for tabular reference actions; probably pre-existing (also in build-r17-g).
workaround: None; build still succeeds.

what: Volume list check (name filter, price sort, 50 rows) took 1204 ms on the first call after a start, over the 1 s limit; the test now sends one warm-up request per list.
why: Cold start (plan cache, JIT) and no declared index on filter and sort columns.
workaround: Warm-up request in level10a test; measurement is warm.

what: mvnd judo-rdbms-schema:apply on an empty PostgreSQL database fails with relation judo_model_versions does not exist; the catalog describes apply as the fresh schema route (dev only).
why: Apply queries a version table that does not exist yet on a fresh database; the documented fresh route does not work on an empty DB in this build.
workaround: pg_restore of a dump from the dev database with --clean; 162 errors ignored on the first run, which restored no products.
proposed_target: judo-rdbms-schema apply on an empty PostgreSQL database

what: Two R18 smoke tests (F71 order not placed, F76 order number never shown) failed after R18; cause found in R19: checkout took about 20 s because derived members of CustomerAccount join over unindexed foreign-key columns with about 1 800 accounts.
why: Generator creates no index on foreign-key columns and the model cannot declare indexes (generator-plugins.md Indexes).
workaround: Slow-query log used to find the joins; indexes added by hand (see c17-13).

what: Karaf log shows NoClassDefFoundError for hu.blackbelt.epsilon EolExecutionContext from the rdbms osgi bundle during the F71 run.
why: Unclear; the test passed on rerun.
workaround: None.
proposed_target: judo rdbms osgi bundle classpath (Epsilon EolExecutionContext)

what: Duplicate imports also appeared on main with no Guest actor, in ImportRunInfo.startImport dialogs, where undo shares its output type ShopMessage with startImport. Builder gave undo its own UndoMessage output and the build passed again. The catalog says a shared output with two actors alone did not reproduce the bug, so the cause is unproven.
why: Unknown; builder inferred a shared output type as the trigger from a single before and after result.
workaround: Changed ImportRunInfo.undo output to a new TO UndoMessage and updated UndoCustomImplementation.java.

what: Adding a ShopInfo access to the anonymous Guest actor fails validate in the transform work with 'Zeta validation result mismatch' (ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding). The free-shipping banner is therefore not shown to guests.
why: Unclear; the error text is not in the catalog (kb search for ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding gave no matching section). The builder records it as a platform problem.
workaround: Access removed with delete --cascade; validate passed again; the banner was left out of the guest CatalogHome.

what: Full ./judo.sh build -i takes about 5 minutes; the builder ran four full builds and several starts in this chunk, mostly for copy and import errors.
why: Frontend build of the Guest and Customer bundles plus generate is slow; each change needs a full build to check.
workaround: Background build with nohup and sleep, then grep for BUILD SUCCESS or error TS.

what: The base route http://localhost:8181/ still shows the platform bundle list, not the Guest app. The Guest app is reached at /webshop/Guest/.
why: The public app has no base route without a public actor and a registered page (R19-16 in GAPS).
workaround: None; the Guest URL was given to the user.
